title: Modeling Ideological Salience and Framing in Polarized Online Groups with Graph Neural Networks and Structured Sparsity
reasoning: The paper explicitly integrates Moral Foundations Theory (Haidt and Joseph, 2004) into its modeling framework to analyze ideological framing. It uses five specific moral subspaces (e.g., care/harm, fairness/cheating, sanctity/degradation) to project language model embeddings and evaluate how different polarized groups utilize these moral frames.
